responsibility_name: Ensure expected deliveries trigger gate access and notification

evidence.evidence_text: When the courier is near, if the user has placed an order online, open the gate and send a message on the mobile

responsibility_name: Ensure only authorised vehicles can open the garage gate

evidence.evidence_text: When a car approaches the entrance gate of the garage of the house, it is identified by a proximity sensor which will automatically trigger an initial recognition check of the car based on the infrared emitted by a specific key. If the first check is unsuccessful, an intelligent camera will scan the license plate trying to match the authorized cars. Once the checks have been carried out, the garage gate will then be opened and the lights inside will be turned on.

responsibility_name: ensure the garage is closed after parking

evidence.evidence_text: When the car enters the garage and if the parked car does not move for 10 seconds, the garage door will close automatically and the lights will turn on.

responsibility_name: ensure the garage is lit after parking

evidence.evidence_text: When the car enters the garage and if the parked car does not move for 10 seconds, the garage door will close automatically and the lights will turn on.

responsibility_name: Ensure the water system is shut off and the owner alerted on leakage

evidence.evidence_text: If I turn off the kitchen tap, all the taps in the house are closed and the water meter continues to measure, the house water system is turned off and the user receives a notification on the phone of a possible lost.

responsibility_name: Ensure waking when the alarm clock is not switched off

evidence.evidence_text: When the user does not switch off the alarm clock, the rolling shutters go up and the light switches on.

responsibility_name: Keep the house warm when the fireplace dies down

evidence.evidence_text: When the fireplace is about to go out with the house not yet warm and it's cold outside, I get a notification on my phone and the heating turns on.
When no one is home, cameras turn on and remote alarm notifications are triggered
When the user is not at home activate the alarm system and close all the shutters.
IF the user is NOT at home DO activate burglar alarm systems AND lock the door lock AND turn off the water and gas.
When it is 11pm on a weekday or 2am on a holiday, if the user is not at home, turn off the lights, lock the windows and the door.
If the user is not at home, enable the alarm and send an SMS notification to the user to notify him of the activation.

When the motion sensors detect the user in the bathroom, if the intercom detects a stranger and the user is using the phone, then he can answer the intercom with the phone and open the gate with the phone

responsibility_name: Prevent bath overflow when left unattended

evidence.evidence_text: When user turns on bathtub faucet, if tub fills and user is not in bathroom, automatically turn off faucet and notify user via Alexa message that tub is ready .

responsibility_name: Prevent fire hazards from unattended heated appliances

evidence.evidence_text: IF the user is NOT at home and forgets the hair straightener is turned ON TURN OFF the power and SEND an alert notification to the user.

responsibility_name: prevent gas and carbon monoxide hazard from stove

evidence.evidence_text: when the sensor detects the ignition of a stove and detects the presence of carbon black and detects the amount of gas in the air greater than 0.08%, turn off the stove, turn on the venola and open the windows.

responsibility_name: prevent harm from gas leaks when unoccupied

evidence.evidence_text: When the infrared sensor does not detect any human and/or animal heat and if a gas leak is detected, a notification is sent to the user and the gas is automatically closed.
When the user is not in the kitchen, the fire sensors are activated and the plates are turned off
If there is a storm outside and the TV is on, turn off the TV and all the lights in the house
